exposure: aspartate aminotransferase to platelet ratio index (APRI)
intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) status (mild/severe/healthy control)
cohort: The study included 238 pregnant women, comprising groups with mild intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, severe intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, and healthy controls.
finding: APRI and De Ritis ratios are simple, inexpensive, and non-invasive markers that may aid in the diagnosis and severity assessment of ICP, with higher APRI values correlating with increased NICU admissions, lower gestational age, and lower birth weight.
